title: Sealed Keystone Crate
hook: The package is sealed and important. Deliver it. Do not open it.

blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: A sealed crate sits in the back of the carriage, heavier than it looks, banded shut, and unmarked. You're told three things: it is important, you are not to open it, and it goes to the village.

blocks.label: Player Read
blocks.body: The package is sealed and important. Deliver it. Do not open it.

affordances: Inspect the label, maker, or fine print.
Use it only when the fiction says you can reach it.
